title: LE,NONET Community Internship A
description: An introduction to practical experience within an Indigenous community or organization setting related to the category of Arts, Literatures and Languages. In consultation with the Experiential Learning Coordinator, Indigenous students identify an area of interest and undertake 120 hours of work under the supervision of a community adviser from an Indigenous community or organization.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of IS 321A, IS 321B, IS 321C, IS 321D.
LE,NONET courses are reserved for Indigenous students.
